::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_notes"}
#docs
Cursor-paginated. `?invoice=inv_…` and `?customer=cus_…` scope the list; the `invoice[<op>]` filter also works but is not listed below because it shares its name with that shorthand.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The credit note's id (cn_…). |
| `data.number` | `string` | Human-readable sequential number ("CN-42"); null on rows predating it. |
| `data.invoice` | `string` | The invoice this note credits (inv_…). |
| `data.invoice_number` | `string` | That invoice's human-readable number ("INV-42"); null on rows predating it. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | adjustment reduces an unpaid invoice; refundable credits the refundable bucket and can be refunded or allocated. One of `adjustment`, `refundable`. |
| `data.status` | `string` | `refunded` means nothing is left available: by a refund, by allocation to invoices, or both. `settled_by` says which. One of `adjusted`, `refund_due`, `refunded`, `voided`. |
| `data.settled_by` | `string` | Set on a `refunded` note: `refund` (cash went back), `allocation` (applied to invoices; `refunded_minor` is 0) or `mixed`. Null on every other status. One of `refund`, `allocation`, `mixed`. |
| `data.reason_code` | `string` | The credit note's reason code. One of `write_off`, `subscription_change`, `subscription_cancellation`, `chargeback`, `other`. |
| `data.subtotal_minor` | `integer` | The GROSS reversal this note documents, PRE-TAX and before any slice was routed back to a credit bucket. Reproduce the note as subtotal_minor − Σ discounts[].amount_minor + tax = total_minor. Notes issued before this was recorded report their total_minor here, with no discounts and no tax. |
| `data.total_minor` | `integer` | The CASHABLE claim — what is refundable or allocatable, NOT the gross. 0 is legitimate: a reversal funded entirely from promotional credit returns all of it to that bucket. |
| `data.allocated_minor` | `integer` | Already applied to invoices. |
| `data.refunded_minor` | `integer` | Already drawn as a refund. |
| `data.available_minor` | `integer` | total_minor − allocated_minor − refunded_minor. |
| `data.payout_unconfirmed_minor` | `integer` | A payout refund the gateway could not confirm (not found). Counted as paid out until a person resolves it with `POST …/credit_notes/{cn}/resolve_payout`, or the gateway answers later (a success settles it as paid, a failure returns it as credit). 0 = nothing to resolve. |
| `data.payout_duplicated_minor` | `integer` | A refund that a person returned as credit and that the gateway later confirmed paid out: the customer has this amount as cash and as credit. We do not take the credit back on our own. A later bounce of that payout lowers it. 0 = none. |
| `data.payout_out_of_order_minor` | `integer` | A refund the gateway reported failed (we returned it as credit) and then reported paid: its answers arrived out of order. Booked as paid; the credit stays. Check the gateway. 0 = none. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The credit note's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.exchange_rate` | `string` | INHERITED from the invoice this note credits, not resolved fresh — so the note and its invoice convert at the same rate and net to zero in a converted book. Same string/direction rules as `Invoice.exchange_rate`; null when the credited invoice carried no rate. |
| `data.exchange_rate_base` | `string` | The exchange rate to the business's default currency at issue. |
| `data.reason` | `string` | Why the credit note was issued. |
| `data.customer_notes` | `string` | A note shown to the customer on the credit note. |
| `data.voided_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit note was voided (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `data.channel` | `string` | Provenance at creation; null on rows predating the column. One of `api`, `dashboard`, `system`, `import`. |
| `data.imported` | `boolean` | Archival row imported from an external system (no ledger postings). |
| `data.metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the credit note. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit note was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.customer` | `string` | The payer (cus_…). Absent on the create receipt. |
| `data.customer_name` | `string` | The customer's name. |
| `data.customer_email` | `string` | The customer's email. |
| `data.items` | `array of object` | The CASHABLE lines, so they sum to total_minor rather than to subtotal_minor — the gap is exactly `discounts[]`. Absent on the create receipt. |
| `data.discounts` | `array of object` | What was taken off subtotal_minor and which bucket it went back to. Amounts are positive magnitudes. Present on the single credit-note read only. |
| `data.taxes` | `array of object` | The `+ tax` term of that identity, split across the components the CREDITED INVOICE booked and named the way the invoice names them ("IGST (18.00%)"). A credit note stores neither the amount nor the names: the amount is the identity rearranged, the names come from the invoice's tax snapshot, in the proportion it booked them. Σ amount_minor === total_minor − subtotal_minor + Σ discounts[].amount_minor. Falls back to a single unnamed "Tax" row when the credited invoice recorded no per-line tax (rows predating it, or an untaxed business). Empty when the note carries no tax. Present on the single credit-note read only. |
| `data.gateway_refundable_minor` | `integer` | Cash on this note's invoice still reversible through a gateway. 0 means a gateway refund is impossible. Present on the single credit-note read only. |
| `data.allocations` | `array of object` | Where this note's credit was applied. Present on the single credit-note read only. |
| `data.refunds` | `array of object` | Refund transactions drawn against this note. Present on the single credit-note read only. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque; pass as starting_after |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Filtered-set count; first page only |
